title: Tianjin Nankai High School
scope: Present exterior of the heritage buildings on the old north campus of Tianjin Nankai High School: Boling East Building, North Building, Fansun Building, Ruiting Auditorium and the two mapped Xizhai dormitory rows. Excludes later classroom blocks, interiors and other campuses.
limitations: Current named footprints are preserved. Several rooms and porch projections are simplified in the model.
Roof pitches, window counts, color, exact ornament, porch dimensions and elevations are approximate.
Original terrain remains unmodified. Individual thresholds and paving elevations are not surveyed.

No reference imagery was adopted. The exact publishing provenance of the historic exterior photographs was not confirmed; other Qualla media shows people and classroom interiors rather than the exterior.
